newsitem.title: USA: LME looking at clearer option/open position data.
newsitem.headline: LME looking at clearer option/open position data.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) is still considering recommendations made by the Securities and Investments Board (SIB) in its 1996 review of the market, and is pondering more transparancy on data on options and large positions, LME Chief Executive David King said.

King said at the American Metal Market forum here that LME is proposing to introduce additional data, via its vendor feed, on options, giving details of premia at various strike prices, the open interest and information at actual trades.
Data on futures trades, open interest, volumes and values of trades after they have taken place are similarly being considered.
"We are also looking again at the merits and otherwise of publishing details of stocks held , by brand, as well as the possibility of daily stock reporting," he said.

Furthermore, the LME is examining suitable mechanisms to enable publication of some form of large position and warrant holding data, without actually naming the holders of such positions or warrants, he added.
